info.name: VINaudit Vehicle History Getownershipcost.php Specifications API

params.name: vin
params.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number. Required if not providing id or YMMT parameters.

params.name: id
params.description: Vehicle ID string in year_make_model_trim format. Required if not providing vin or YMMT parameters.

params.name: year
params.description: Vehicle model year. Required for YMMT lookup.

params.name: make
params.description: Vehicle make (lowercase). Required for YMMT lookup.

params.name: model
params.description: Vehicle model (lowercase). Required for YMMT lookup.

params.name: trim
params.description: Vehicle trim level (lowercase). Optional for YMMT lookup.

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated list of data sections to include in response. If omitted, all sections are returned.

items.docs: Retrieve standardized vehicle specifications. Supports three lookup methods: by VIN, by vehicle ID string, or by year/make/model/trim (YMMT). Use the include parameter to filter which data sections are returned.
